title: Reserve open cloze
instructions: Supply one word for each gap. Complete all five before submitting the protected form.

parts.prompt: Gap 1: supply the indefinite article required before “map”.

response.rationale: Map is a singular count noun beginning with a consonant sound.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.

parts.prompt: Gap 2: supply the relative word referring to places used during lunch.

response.rationale: Where introduces a clause describing what happens at the places.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Where” links the places to the activity occurring there.

parts.prompt: Gap 3: supply the conjunction giving the reason for repeating the survey.

response.rationale: The movement of shadows is the reason for repeating observations.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Because” introduces the reason; “as” and “since” are also acceptable here.

parts.prompt: Gap 4: supply the determiner showing that all groups individually used the same symbols.

response.rationale: Each or every distributes the shared method across the singular noun group.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Each” emphasises every individual group; “every” is also acceptable.

parts.prompt: Gap 5: supply the preposition showing that reviewing observations happened earlier than making recommendations.
parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Before” establishes the correct sequence of review and recommendation.
